one_liner: SE Ranking offers a broad REST Data/Project API with API-key auth, a 14-day trial with 100K credits, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Single API key generated in API Dashboard, sent as 'Authorization: Token KEY' or apikey query param. MCP server supports OAuth, but the REST API documents only API keys.
access_notes: 14-day trial with 100K free credits and full API access; afterwards pay-as-you-go from $50 or a paid plan. No permanent free tier.
blocker_notes: Only a 14-day trial (100K credits) is free; ongoing testing needs a paid plan or $50 PAYG credits. The trial is enough to build, so friction is modest.

evidence.quote: Include an `Authorization` header in your request, with the value `Token YOUR_API_KEY`.
A single API key authenticates every endpoint across the Data API and the Project API.
14-day trial to test every API endpoint
Start with a 14-day trial that includes **100,000 free API credits**.
The base URL for all endpoints is: https://api.seranking.com
Data across keyword research, domain analysis, backlinks, website audits, and more — all in one MCP server.
MCP server server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so it’s centrally hosted and managed.
add a custom connector with the URL https://api.seranking.com/mcp, name it **SE Ranking**, and authorize with OAuth or your API key.
